question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

To brood deeply over something
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Reflecting seriously". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To brood deeply over something"** means to think about something seriously or dwell on it for a prolonged period. (किसी बात पर गंभीरता से विचार करना या लंबे समय तक उस पर मनन करना) • **Example:** She brooded deeply over the decision to leave her job and start her own business. • **"Reflecting seriously"** means to think deeply or carefully about a particular subject or situation. (गंभीरता से विचार करना) • **Example:** He spent the weekend reflecting seriously on how to improve his relationships with his family. • Hence, the idiom "To brood deeply over something" is best explained by the phrase "Reflecting seriously". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Eating absent-mindedly** (अनमने ढंग से खाना): Eating without paying attention, often due to distraction or preoccupation. • **Example:** He was so engrossed in his book that he kept eating absent-mindedly without realizing he had finished the entire bowl of snacks. • **Thinking casually** (सामान्य रूप से सोचना): Thinking in a light, superficial, or not very serious manner. • **Example:** She was just thinking casually about vacation plans and hadn't made any concrete decisions yet. • **Planning aggressively** (आक्रामक रूप से योजना बनाना): Making plans in a bold or assertive manner. • **Example:** The company is planning aggressively to expand its operations in international markets. 37:T98f, The correct answer is: **Reformer**.
